reviewMethod: Actual 36 JPEG contact pages were visually viewed, showing each CPU front/back/oblique alongside distinct retained manufacturer photos. This is screening, not blanket acceptance or a calibrated overlay. No source assets were edited.
limitations: Reference views are not pose calibrated; some references show kits or optional components.
One SKU m5stack-c147 has no retained reference photographs in the source model directory.
No lighting/material calibration or physical-device measurements; 12 Cycles samples may be noisy.
MeshBasic and MeshStandard maps are present; exporter reports no custom shader or unsupported material features for all141.
Textured negative polygonOffset surfaces are displaced0.005mm along actual transformed normals only in CPU export; alphaTest is binary clipping.
Canvas lettering uses DejaVu Sans Mono substitute; exact browser font/antialiasing is not validated.

PaperMono existing rear-nfc-albedo.webp is documented by the source model as a previous ImageGen-edited texture. It is used only as model pixels; reference-photo-08.webp is the genuine separate reference photograph. No images were generated or edited by an image-generation system for this QA.
All display textures are blank black; no static firmware screen is presented as guest output.
CPU images supplement but do not claim browser WebGL/DOM acceptance.
